home.title: One team setup for every DSH.
home.tagline: Publish models, presets and plugin pins once; every member's DeepSeek Harness picks them up.

team.title: Team console
team.overview: Team configuration lives beside each member's local setup; team models run through the platform and provider keys stay on the server.

join.title: Join a team
join.description: Paste the invitation link or token an admin gave you.

leave.confirm: Leave this team? Its configuration disappears from your DSH at the next sync.

configs.title: Team configuration
configs.presetNote: DSH checks tool availability inside the session; a preset never installs or authorizes a tool. Start a new session to use a new version.

form.name: Name
form.providesTools: Tools it provides (DSH names, one per line)
form.catalogUnavailable: The provider's model list is unavailable; type the model id.
form.catalogEmpty: The provider returned no models; type the model id.
form.limitsHint: Leave a limit empty when the provider does not state it.
form.keepOwnRoute: Keep this preset's own provider and model
form.pluginsHint: A team declaration only: it does not install or authorize anything. Run /team tools in DSH to see real tool names.
form.systemPromptHint: Rules the model must follow go here; the fields above describe the preset to people.
form.saved: Saved. Members get it at their next sync.

plugin.description: Only continue if you just ran /team login in your own DSH.

plugin.expiry: The code works once, for two minutes, and only for the DSH that asked for it.

setup.title: Create the first account
setup.description: This instance has no account yet. Create yours, then create your team and add the others.
setup.closed: This link no longer works: the first account already exists.

password.title: Change your password
password.mustChange: Your team admin set this password for you. Choose your own before you continue.
password.hint: At least 10 characters. A few unrelated words are easy to remember and hard to guess.
